status: Prospective interpretation plan during frozen numerical execution; no outcomes read and no source/protocol changes

boundary.purpose: Define what would justify adopting or rejecting the frozen primary after the complete archive, independent audit and summary are ready. This is a logical plan, not a prefilled outcome judgment.

fixed_primary_contract.sensitivity: benefit_cost_remaining_H, separately reported and never a replacement/fallback chosen from these outcomes
fixed_primary_contract.objective: Expected original-H annualized real log growth is a declared normative criterion, not an elicited utility or an implication forced by the contest.
fixed_primary_contract.optional_action: Current paid restoration is optional only if its empirical mean one-year paired NET log-growth advantage exceeds1e-12 and its original-H buy-and-hold empirical breach count does not exceed hold. Otherwise hold. These are declared predicates, not a theorem of optimal rebalancing.
fixed_primary_contract.inception: Own-training common-state positive initial economic estimate is a deployment condition. Once admitted, execute the approved initial target and charge the fee mandatorily. Do not apply the optional all-bill risk-direction veto at inception; Q1 and complete-policy admission assess the approved initial risk allocation.
fixed_primary_contract.service_risk: The fixed10% absolute benchmark and same-target B-relative caps are extra declared service rules. They are not questionnaire estimates, statistical confidence levels or contest-mandated exact numbers.

what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.formula: At the same causal state x,V,u and approved target w, execute_target supplies exact current C and z=(V-C)w. For joint next-year gross g_j, Bhat=mean_j log((w dot g_j)/(u dot g_j)), chat=-log1p(-C/V), Deltahat=Bhat-chat=mean_j log((z dot g_j)/(x dot g_j)). The current fee enters once.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.sufficient_for: Deltahat>1e-12 is sufficient to satisfy this explicitly adopted local estimated economic predicate, under the specified equal-weight same-calendar training law and log-wealth measure. It explains in common units why the model expects the optional trade to cover its current fee over its stated benefit horizon.
not_sufficient_for: A calibrated positive true conditional expected gain at this observed state
A positive realized gain on the next actual return
Larger complete original-H realized or expected growth than B or every feasible policy
Full-H MDD chance feasibility or lower MDD severity
Statistical proof that the economic advantage is positive
An optimal adaptive policy or an independent validation certificate
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.necessary_for_our_optional_rule: Every optional restore in this frozen controller must satisfy it by definition. If a trace shows a negative-net optional restore, that is an implementation/audit issue, not a permitted risk exception.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.not_necessary_from_the_problem: The phrase estimated benefit justifies cost does not uniquely mandate one-year expected log gain. Benefit could instead be defined in arithmetic wealth, a longer holding interval, reduction of tail risk, preservation of a preauthorized risk profile, or an explicitly elicited multiattribute objective. A justified risk hedge may have negative short-run expected growth. Our rule intentionally excludes such trades rather than claiming the contest prohibits them.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.not_unique: Log utility gives a principled common measure and diminishing marginal value; it is a modeling choice. Expected log improvement is different from log expected wealth and from expected currency profit. One-year versus remaining-H benefit and the extra direction veto are also substantive design choices.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.why_one_year_main: It matches the interval between annual reviews and avoids inventing future adaptive trades for the economic contrast. Complete-H evaluation remains essential because one action changes subsequent holdings/costs. This is a transparent local approximation, not a derivation of global optimality.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.why_remaining_H_is_only_sensitivity: Trade-once-then-hold through original H can amortize the current cost, but actual annual replanning need not honor that holding promise. Its result diagnoses continuation assumptions without selecting the main model after outcomes.
what_benefit_exceeds_cost_means.not_statistical_independence: Separate risk gate means an additional logical constraint. It does not mean its estimates are statistically independent of the growth estimate, Q1 target, training data, inner fit or other repeats.

role_of_the_risk_layers.local_direction: The two full-H buy-and-hold branches retain actual past CPI/peak/MDD, original horizon and current exact paid restoration. k_restore<=k_hold is a model-relative direction veto. It is not an absolute10% bound or a comparison to the future adaptive execution of B.
role_of_the_risk_layers.whole_policy_training: The executed complete controller must satisfy k<=min(kB,floor(.1n+tol)) on its own training paths; every actual fee, hold, future decision and pending period matters.
role_of_the_risk_layers.inner: Positive automatic evidence U and the two same-U held-out count conditions check the learned procedure, not just a target or individual action. The B-relative condition can reject even when the absolute10% condition passes; this is our declared conservatism, not a law of suitability.
role_of_the_risk_layers.final_refit: Passing inner evidence is not automatically inherited by a new full-data target/forecast state. The final controller must still pass its own initial economic and complete training rules; unsupported Q1 retains priority.
role_of_the_risk_layers.no_theorem: Calendar fan forecasts are not proved conditional on observed state. Empirical action screens, nested reused paths and source audits do not guarantee population10% risk. Equal breach counts can hide different severity and recovery outcomes.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The current client/product contract is unsupported or outside this execution study. Economics/risk execution may be unassessed; do not label uncomputed gains zero or negative.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: The benefit-cost controller failed economically, or a safer portfolio does not exist.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The approved initial target does not have a positive estimated net advantage over keeping the initial bills under this architecture horizon and own empirical training law; this controller is undeployable.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: The target can never be worthwhile over longer horizons or under another defensible benefit definition.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.observed_stage: Positive initial economics but complete training cap fails
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The economic rationale and this complete controller risk-service feasibility do not jointly meet the declared training requirements. Identify whether absolute alpha, B-relative cap or both bind.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: Positive optional action estimates prove a whole-H gain, or all feasible causal controllers are impossible.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The architecture has no automatic inner evidence under the stated Q1/economic/training procedure. Financial risk on this absent service population isNULL.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: Risk is0 or an annual reference return may stand in for refused service.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The held-out automatic subpopulation does not meet our fixed absolute empirical risk evidence rule. Preserve k,n and threshold; this is inadequate approval support.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: An exact probability theorem proves true risk exceeds10%.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.observed_stage: Inner same-U B-relative gate fails only
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The method meets the absolute empirical cap but has more events than its appropriate reference on exactly the same inner automatic IDs; it fails our added relative nonworsening evidence requirement.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: It necessarily violates the contest or every reasonable client preference.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.observed_stage: Inner passes but final own target/refit training fails
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The evidence did not transfer to the final learned component under the preserved contract. Report the changed target/initial estimate/risk cap without relaxing them.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: Use the former inner target, a favorable old seed or a sensitivity controller as an unannounced deployment substitute.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.observed_stage: Training/inner pass but outer realized risk is worse
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: Prespecified empirical approval was not a future safety guarantee. Show same-population financial comparisons, severity, denominator changes and repeat-level variability.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: Retune gates using those outer outcomes, drop an unfavorable repeat, or call passing source audit market calibration.

prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.observed_stage: Primary qualifies in final full120 fit
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.permitted_interpretation: The primary is the chosen executable model for this client under its declared empirical approval rules, with limitations. Full120 financial simulation is in-sample; recurring OOF summaries describe development stability.
prospective_outcome_interpretation_matri.forbidden_inference: The final target has independent validation, a known10% true-risk ceiling or universally superior growth.

if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.main_model_identity: Keep the frozen primary identity and the full algorithm that maps training evidence to Automated/Review. A reject option is part of this service model, not a reason to silently replace its execution controller.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.no_global_infeasibility_claim: Say no automatically deployable version of this fixed controller was supported by this fit and its declared evidence rules. Do not say no safe/profitable portfolio, no feasible causal policy or no mathematical solution exists.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.conflict_precision: Positive initial or local trade estimates can coexist with failure of original-H risk conditions. This is an economic-opportunity versus risk-service conflict within the chosen candidate/controller class, conditional on the forecast and evidence rules. Initial economic failure is a different conflict and must be reported separately.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.coverage: Preserve all original IDs and fit statuses. Review financial outcomes stayNULL; neither B, sensitivity, equal weights, bills nor a hypothetical perfect adviser supplies customer service returns. Hypothetical reference outcomes may be shown only in labelled separate comparisons.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.risk_of_hold: Holding current assets after an optional veto is an actual controller action and can itself create risk. The complete-policy risk check, not the local veto, decides if the service can be offered.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.pending_distinction: For an already deployed customer whose actual breach later occurs, pending hold remains a fully simulated realized path under the original contract. Do not confuse it with predeployment Review and delete its adverse returns.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.honest_next_action: Explain which explicit rule bound and why. Any genuinely different risk hedge, conservative initial allocation, customer clarification, conditional law or elicited preference would be a separately specified future model or human decision. This run does not add it after seeing rejection.
if_some_or_all_C_are_rejected.success_definition: A coherent formula, faithful implementation, explicit uncertainty and principled rejection can be a defensible model result. Broad automatic coverage is not evidence of quality if achieved by changing the task or hidden fallback.

Count failure reasons at their actual fit/job levels. When reason precedence hides coexisting failures, inspect saved initial eligibility, training eligibility and inner gate predicates/reasons rather than force one causal explanation.
Check optional restore count equals positive-net-and-direction-compliant optional count; check exact quote/charged cost and inception exception separately.
Report each repeat original120 denominator and fit24 denominator; auto-only risk/returns are conditional, no-auto isNULL; no600-IID pooling or confidence claims.

Compare primary, sensitivity and old controllers only on identical repeat/fold/context/original-ID common-auto sets. A changed automatic population can change a risk fraction without any same-path economic change.

Give the final adoption decision using fixed method identity and predeclared gates, then separately describe descriptive evidence and assumptions; never choose the sensitivity because its outer result is nicer.
